118292.name: The Shul - Jack & Miriam Shenkman Building
118292.note: Nov 1994: Lubavitch of Michigan brought Rabbi Kasriel and Itty Shemtov to West Bloomfield; 'the Shul', the planned synagogue outreach center of the Campus of Living Judaism, not yet built (Jewish News); the July 2024 list also gives 1994. Before its building: the Jewish News synagogue directory lists The Shul at '6211 Quaker Hill Drive, West Bloomfield 48322 ... Rabbi: Kasriel Shemtov' (Nov 12 1999, Nov 17 2000), and at '6890 W. Maple, West Bloomfield' by Sept 29 2005 (https://digital.bentley.umich.edu/djnews/djn.2005.09.29.001/145), so it moved into the Shenkman Building between 2000 and 2005.

earlier.where: 6211 Quaker Hill Drive, West Bloomfield (its address in the Jewish News synagogue directory, Nov 1999 and Nov 2000)

119457.name: Camp Gan Israel-Kalkaska
119457.note: Camp Gan Israel Detroit, 'Established 5721 - 1961' (shluchim.org camp directory); now in Kalkaska Township. Where it was: the Jewish News, Aug 18 2000: 'The Chabad overnight camp, Camp Gan Israel/Esther Allan, purchased in Fenton by the Shemtovs in their first year here, has moved to Kalkaska'; it was at 'Route 1, Box 272, Lake Valley Road, Kalkaska' by May 1987 (https://digital.bentley.umich.edu/djnews/djn.1987.05.15.001/61). When it left Fenton wasn't found.

earlier.where: Fenton, Michigan (the camp 'purchased in Fenton by the Shemtovs in their first year here', before it moved to Kalkaska)
